description: Helicopter placed in the gardens in 1974, moved there from the Accra Air Force Base under the Acheampong government as an exhibit rather than as a crash relic. Still present but badly deteriorated: a Graphic Online report of 10 May 2024 describes the tail boom, rudder and rotor mast detaching and cracking in the cockpit and cabin, and notes that a replacement airframe has been approved and is waiting at Takoradi Air Force Base for funds to move it. Recorded as on display because it is a deliberately placed exhibit in a public garden, not an abandoned airframe on a ramp. No serial or registration has been found in any source, so tail_number is blank. A Tripadvisor answer identifies it as an H-19D of ex-UN Congo stock, but that is single-sourced and the variant is therefore left blank.
